crossRefs.note: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and don’t tell the truth.
If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen…
You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning…
Behold, I give some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will…
Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God, and this is the spirit of…
You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is…
For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is…
For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation…
Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
translations.bsb: Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.
translations.kjv: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
translations.asv: Who is the liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, even he that denieth the Father and the Son.
